description: Provenance matrix of every reported Q13790 glycosite against source PMID and sample type
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Provenance of every GlyGen-reported Q13790 glycosite, sample type taken from each source abstract (PubMed)
rec=[
 ("N118","N",23090970,"breast cancer cell-line secretome + human plasma","body fluid/secretome"),
 ("N118","N",29391424,"24 human serum samples","body fluid"),
 ("N118","N",29741879,"breast cancer xenograft + CPTAC breast tumour tissue","tissue"),
 ("N118","N",37074911,"ccRCC tumour and normal kidney tissue","tissue"),
 ("N139","N",29391424,"24 human serum samples","body fluid"),
 ("N139","N",29741879,"breast cancer xenograft + CPTAC breast tumour tissue","tissue"),
 ("N139","N",30237853,"urine, prostate cancer vs BPH","body fluid"),
 ("N139","N",37074911,"ccRCC tumour and normal kidney tissue","tissue"),
 ("N267","N",29391424,"24 human serum samples","body fluid"),
 ("N267","N",37074911,"ccRCC tumour and normal kidney tissue","tissue"),
 ("T57","O",30459171,"human kidney tissue, T cells, serum (EXoO)","mixed"),
 ("S59","O",30459171,"human kidney tissue, T cells, serum (EXoO)","mixed"),
 ("T274","O",22171320,"human urine","body fluid"),
 ("S302","O",30459171,"human kidney tissue, T cells, serum (EXoO)","mixed"),
 ("S303","O",30459171,"human kidney tissue, T cells, serum (EXoO)","mixed"),
 ("251-279 (range)","O",28035807,"human serum O-GalNAc glycoproteome","body fluid")]
P=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=["site","type","pmid","sample_source","source_class"])
P["segment"]=P.site.map(lambda s: "propeptide 36-164" if s in ("T57","S59","N118","N139") else "mature 165-326")
P["uniprot_annotated"]=P.site.map(lambda s: {"N118":"yes (ECO:0000255 prediction)","T274":"yes (ECO:0000269)"}.get(s,"no"))
pd.set_option('display.width',250); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',52)
print(P.to_string(index=False))
P.to_csv('apof_glycosite_provenance.csv',index=False)

summ=(P.groupby(["segment","site","type","uniprot_annotated"])
       .agg(n_sources=("pmid","nunique"),
            body_fluid_sources=("source_class",lambda x:int(sum(v in("body fluid","body fluid/secretome","mixed") for v in x))),
            pmids=("pmid",lambda x:";".join(map(str,sorted(set(x)))))).reset_index())
print("\n=== Per-site summary ===")
print(summ.to_string(index=False))

sites=["T57","S59","N118","N139","N267","T274","S302","S303"]
pmids=sorted(P[P.site.isin(sites)].pmid.unique())
Mx=pd.DataFrame(0,index=sites,columns=pmids)
for _,r in P[P.site.isin(sites)].iterrows(): Mx.loc[r.site,r.pmid]=1 if r.source_class=="tissue" else 2
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.6))
im=ax.imshow(Mx.values,cmap=plt.cm.colors.ListedColormap(["#f2f2f2","#b08968","#2a6f97"]),vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(pmids))); ax.set_xticklabels([f"PMID\n{p}" for p in pmids],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sites)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{s}  {'[propeptide]' if s in ('T57','S59','N118','N139') else '[mature]'}"
                    +("  *UniProt*" if s in ("N118","T274") else "") for s in sites],fontsize=8.5)
ax.axhline(3.5,color='k',lw=2)
for i in range(len(sites)):
    for j in range(len(pmids)):
        if Mx.values[i,j]: ax.text(j,i,"x",ha='center',va='center',color='w',fontsize=9)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(color="#2a6f97",label="serum / plasma / urine"),Patch(color="#b08968",label="tissue or xenograft"),
                   Patch(color="#f2f2f2",label="not reported")],fontsize=8,loc='upper left',bbox_to_anchor=(1.01,1))
ax.set_title("Experimental support per Q13790 glycosite and the sample type it came from\n(GlyGen records; sample type read from each source abstract)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
